meta_title: McCormack B & Sons | Tree Surgery Liverpool
meta_description: McCormack B & Sons are experienced arborists in Liverpool. Professional tree surgery, felling, and maintenance. Free quotes available. Call today.
hero_subhead: Dangerous branch hanging over your roof? We safely remove, trim, and maintain trees across Liverpool with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to emergency felling, we handle every aspect of professional tree care safely and responsibly.

services.title: Emergency Tree Felling
services.desc: Storm damage, diseased trees, or dangerous limbs — we remove hazardous trees quickly and safely, with full site clearance and waste removal.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Shaping
services.desc: Thin out overcrowded canopies and reduce tree height to protect your property and neighbours. Improves light and air flow to your garden.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular pruning keeps trees healthy, reduces disease risk, and prevents costly damage to buildings, fences, and utilities.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Complete stump extraction using specialist equipment. Reclaim garden space and eliminate trip hazards in one visit.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Cutting
services.desc: Keep boundaries tidy and safe. We trim hedges to shape, manage overgrowth, and dispose of all cuttings.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Expert inspection to identify disease, structural weakness, or safety risks. Detailed report and recommendations for remedial work.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it's part of our own garden — careful, honest, and done right first time.
about_para_1: McCormack B & Sons has been caring for Liverpool's trees for nearly two decades. Founded on a simple principle — that skilled arboricultural work should be safe, affordable, and transparent — we've built a solid reputation among homeowners and businesses across the city. Our team holds all relevant qualifications and works to current health and safety standards on every job.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen, explain the work clearly, and never oversell. Whether you need an emergency response at midnight or a routine trim in spring, we bring the same professionalism and attention to detail. We're not the flashiest outfit, but we're reliable, fair-priced, and we leave your garden looking better than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Our Work

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was dangerous after the storm. McCormack came out same day, assessed it properly, quoted a fair price, and the lads did a brilliant job. Whole tree down, stumps ground out, and the garden swept clean in one afternoon. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Found a fungal infection on our beech tree. Rather than just telling us to chop it down, they explained exactly what it was and what we could do. Treated it, pruned carefully, and the tree is thriving now. That's proper service.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Hedge was completely out of control and blocking our drive. Got a quote same week, work done beautifully. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished early. Fair price and no hidden charges. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Robert T.
